interpretation.nvml_pid_namespace_origin: NVML reports16 foreign-to-visible-proc IDs with process_name [Not Found]; consistent with outer host PID reporting, but no accessible host-proc mapping certifies pair identities.
interpretation.conclusion_zh: 自有worker/torchrun/16rank与SSH同一PIDnamespace，不能说SSH与learner各在不同namespace。NVML的16个PID不可见且进程名Not Found，与NVML报告外层PID相符；当前NSpid只给内层PID，无法完成16对16精确映射。相同8UUID、两组rank0..7和内存数量仅支持一致性，不能替代逐PID归属证明。
interpretation.minimal_next_step: 仅在可读取合法host-proc或调度平台可信 PID mapping 后，按 hostPID→containerPID→start_ticks→PPid chain→exact job/UUID做窄映射收据；当前不放宽owner准入，等待其它合法lane自然释放。
